item.title: Ponderings by Doug
item.description: Every so often, Scripture taps us on the shoulder and whispers a truth we’d rather not admit out loud—especially not in front of the church council. item.title: Lady Cougars travel to Arcadia with District 1-1A title on the line
item.description: By Malcolm Butler For the second straight season, Cedar Creek and Arcadia will face off with the District 1-1A title on the line. item.title: Lady Bearcats fall just short in exciting matchup with Neville
item.description: By Kyle Roberts RUSTON, La. — The night would go down to the proverbial wire Monday night in the Ruston High Main Gym between two rivals with district title implications on their minds. item.title: Reported robbery leads to drug arrests
item.description: The investigation of a reported arm robbery led to two drug arrests in Ruston last week. item.title: Texas fugitive stopped by trooper in Ruston
item.description: Louisiana State Police arrested a Ruston man last week after he was stopped for a traffic violation and it was found he was wanted on felony charges in Texas. Malik Armond Mason, 27, was stopped in Ruston by a state trooper on February 4 for operating a vehicle with an inoperative headlight. item.title: Carrier steps down at Experience Ruston; search for next President/CEO begins
item.description: Courtesy of Experience Ruston Experience Ruston (Ruston Lincoln Convention & Visitors Bureau) announced that Amanda Carrier will be stepping down from her role as President & CEO, effective February 13, concluding 13 years of dedicated service to the organization and the regional tourism industry. item.title: Agenda set for tonight’s police jury meeting
item.description: The Lincoln Parish Police Jury will conduct its monthly meeting tonight, starting with a Solid Waste and Recycling Committee meeting at 5:30 p.m. followed by the regular meeting at 6 p.m. These meetings will take place in the Police Jury Meeting Room at 100 West Texas Avenue. The public is invited.
